title: How should three ovens be balanced when cylinders require two curing stages?
summary: An August 2026 Suneng proposal for wound cylinders assigns two furnaces to first-stage curing and one to second-stage curing. Assess the handover between the two stages before effective operating time, transfer and fixture traceability. The three furnaces do not process three independent streams of finished products.
